cards.name: N's Plan
cards.text: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Naveen
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 5 in hand. Before drawing you may discard any number of cards from your hand.

cards.name: Ortega
cards.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. If you put a card on the bottom of your opponent's deck in this way, your opponent may draw a card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Perrin
cards.text: Reveal up to 2 Pokémon in your hand and put them into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to that many Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Philippe
cards.text: Attach up to 2 Basic [M] Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your [M] Pokémon.

cards.name: Pokémon Center Lady
cards.text: Heal 60 damage and remove all Special Conditions from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Professor Sada's Vitality
cards.text: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Professor Turo's Scenario
cards.text: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Professor's Research
cards.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Raifort
cards.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and discard any number of them. Put the other cards back in any order. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Rosa's Encouragement
cards.text: Usable only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach up to 2 Basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

cards.name: Roxie's Performance
cards.text: During your opponent's next turn, their Poisoned Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.name: Ruffian
cards.text: Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
cards.text: Usable only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Salvatore
cards.text: Search your deck for a card with no Abilities that evolves from one of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon, even one played this turn.

cards.name: Surfer
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Tarragon
cards.text: Put up to 4 in any combination of [F] Pokémon and Basic [F] Energy from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Archer
cards.text: Usable only if one of your Team Rocket's Pokémon was Knocked Out last turn. Both players shuffle their hand into their deck; you draw 5, your opponent draws 3.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 5 in hand, or 8 instead if all your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
cards.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with a Benched one. If you do, switch in one of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Proton
cards.text: Usable on your first turn if you go first. Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Tyme
cards.text: Tell your opponent the name of a Pokémon in your hand and put that Pokémon face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses that Pokémon's HP, and then you reveal it. If your opponent guessed right, they draw 4 cards. If they guessed wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then, return the Pokémon to your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Urbain
cards.text: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Waitress
cards.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Wally's Compassion
cards.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you did, put all Energy attached to it into your hand.

cards.name: Xerosic's Machinations
cards.text: Your opponent discards cards from their hand until they have 3 cards in their hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Adversity Policy
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has Weakness to your opponent's Active Pokémon's type, is in the Active Spot, and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is [C][C] less.

cards.name: Amulet of Hope
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Ancient Booster Energy Capsule
cards.text: The Ancient Pokémon this card is attached to gets +60 HP, recovers from all Special Conditions, and can't be affected by any Special Conditions. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Babiri Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Metal Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Backtrack Badge
cards.text: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of the Colorless Pokémon this card is attached to, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again.

cards.name: Binding Mochi
cards.text: Attacks used by the Poisoned Pokémon this card is attached to do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Brave Bangle
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Bravery Charm
cards.text: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Colbur Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Darkness Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Core Memory
cards.text: The Mega Zygarde ex this is attached to can use Geobuster [F][F][F][F] 350, which discards all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Counter Gain
cards.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost Colorless less. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Cynthia's Power Weight
cards.text: The Cynthia's Pokémon this card is attached to gets +70 HP.

cards.name: Deluxe Bomb
cards.text: If the Pokémon this is attached to is Active and is damaged by an attack, put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon, then discard this card.

cards.name: Future Booster Energy Capsule
cards.text: The Future Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost, and the attacks it uses do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Gravity Gemstone
cards.text: While the Pokémon this is attached to is Active, the Retreat Cost of both Active Pokémon is [C] more.

cards.name: Haban Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Dragon Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Handheld Fan
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), move an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Heavy Baton
cards.text: If the Pokémon this is attached to has Retreat Cost exactly 4, is Active and is Knocked Out by an attack, move up to 3 Basic Energy from it to your Bench.

cards.name: Hero's Cape
cards.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +100 HP.

cards.name: Hop's Choice Band
cards.text: Attacks by the Hop's Pokémon this is attached to cost [C] less and do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Light Ball
cards.text: Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Lillie's Pearl
cards.text: If the Lillie's Pokémon this is attached to is Knocked Out by an attack, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

cards.name: Lucky Helmet
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 2 cards. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Maximum Belt
cards.text: Attacks by the Pokémon this is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.

cards.name: Occa Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this is attached to is damaged by an opponent's [R] Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage, then discard this card.

cards.name: Passho Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Water Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Payapa Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this is attached to is damaged by an opponent's [P] Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage, then discard this card.

cards.name: Powerglass
cards.text: At the end of your turn (after your attack), if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to it.

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.text: If the [D] Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack (even if Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Rescue Board
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this is attached to is [C] less, or zero if its remaining HP is 30 or less.

cards.name: Sacred Charm
cards.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Sparkling Crystal
cards.text: Attacks used by the Tera Pokémon this is attached to cost 1 Energy less, of any type.

cards.name: Survival Brace
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. If the Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. Then, discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Hypnotizer
cards.text: If the Team Rocket's Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket's Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Technical Machine: Fluorite
cards.text: Fluorite [G][W][P] — Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and heal all damage from each of your Tera Pokémon. The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Thick Scale
cards.text: The Dragon Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Grass, Fire, Water, or Lightning Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Tremendous Bomb
cards.text: If the non-Mega Pokémon this is attached to is Active and takes 240+ damage from a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon and discard this card.

_imported.note: Imported cards carry "imported": true. Their attack costs and damage are modelled; ability and Trainer effect text is NOT converted into game logic.
